name: Yang Bay
kicker: The forest waterfall and the lake
summary: Forest waterfall inland: walk the falls and the lake on a day about 38 to 40 km from the city. The general ticket is 120,000 VND. A mineral-bath combo is 250,000 VND, and the mud-bath combo is 390,000 VND. Give the park a day away from the sand.
dotReason: A full inland day for the falls, with a mud-bath combo on the top ticket, separate from the beach.
getThere: About 38 to 40 km from the centre, in Khánh Vĩnh.
heroCaption: The stepped falls and the pool at Yang Bay

notice.title: The mud bath is the top ticket
notice.body: The general gate is 120,000 VND. The mineral bath is the 250,000 VND combo. The mud bath is the 390,000 VND combo.

body: Yang Bay is the waterfall park about 38 to 40 km inland, at Khánh Phú in Khánh Vĩnh. The falls are low and sit on a lake. Walk Yang Bay 1, Yang Bay 2, Hố Cho, and Yang Khang. The Raglai name is heavenly waterfall.

Tickets are 120,000 VND general, 250,000 VND with the mineral bath, and 390,000 VND with the mineral bath and the mud bath. Buy the top ticket if the mud is the reason you came. The park also has the Khánh Sơn lithophone, a Raglai stage with gongs, a flower field of more than 10,000 m², and a night in a tent.

figures.caption: The lake shore and the path beside the water

gettingThere: Ride to Khánh Phú, Khánh Vĩnh, about 38 to 40 km from the centre. The name is also attached to 77 Yersin, a city street. The forest park is in Khánh Vĩnh.

legs.heading: From the centre
legs.body: Same inland ride. Plan the day around the falls, and add the mud bath only on the 390,000 VND ticket.
